title: Cosmic Void Mystic
description: A bald figure with pale skin and pink eyes sits centered with arms outstretched, wearing a checkered robe. Behind them is a swirling galaxy with a large turquoise circular portal containing a black void, a radiant sun above, dark mountains below, and floating crystals and leaves.
prompt: A surreal stained glass style artwork featuring a bald mystic with white skin and glowing pink eyes sitting centered with arms raised, wearing a green and gold checkered robe. Behind the figure is a large turquoise spiraling portal with a black void at its center, set against a vibrant pink and purple galaxy with stars. A golden sun radiates at the top, dark jagged mountains sit below, and floating black leaves and colorful crystals surround the scene, all framed by a colorful geometric stained glass border.
